title.en: Volume 469 Biographies 256: En Ming, Fu Qi, Feng Shan, Duan Fang younger brother: Duan Jin, with: Liu Sui, He Cheng E, Song Shou, Zhao Erfeng, Feng Rukui, Lu Zhongqi son: Guang Xi Deng
title.raw: 卷469 列傳二百五十六 恩铭 孚琦 凤山 端方弟：端锦 附：刘燧 赫成额 松寿 赵尔豐 冯汝骙 陆鍾琦子：光熙等

sentences.zh: 列傳二百五十六

translations.literal: Biographies 256
translations.idiomatic: Biography 256

sentences.zh: 恩銘孚琦鳳山端方弟端錦劉燧赫成額

translations.literal: En Ming, Fu Qi, Feng Shan, Duan Fang, younger brother Duan Jin, Liu Sui, He Cheng'e
translations.idiomatic: The subjects of this chapter are En Ming, Fu Qi, Feng Shan, Duan Fang (and his younger brother Duan Jin), Liu Sui, and He Cheng'e.

sentences.zh: 松壽趙爾豐馮汝騤陸鍾琦子光熙等

translations.literal: Song Shou, Zhao Erfeng, Feng Rukui, Lu Zhongqi's son Guangxi and others
translations.idiomatic: Also covered are Song Shou, Zhao Erfeng, Feng Rukui, and Lu Zhongqi's son Guangxi and others.

sentences.zh: 恩銘，字新甫，於庫里氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，錦州駐防。

translations.literal: En Ming, style name Xinfu, of the Yukuli clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner, stationed at the garrison in Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: En Ming, style Xinfu, was of the Yukuli clan, a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner stationed at the Jinzhou garrison.

sentences.zh: 以舉人納貲為知縣，累官至知府。

translations.literal: Through his juren degree he purchased the post of county magistrate and rose through offices to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Having qualified as a provincial graduate, he bought his way into the post of county magistrate and eventually rose to prefect.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，權知兗州，晉道員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu he acted as administrator of Yanzhou and was promoted to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In 1885 he served as acting prefect of Yanzhou and was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，改官山西。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，署按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he acted as provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 拳匪擾晉，恩銘請巡撫毓賢陰護送教士出境，弗聽。

translations.literal: When Boxer bandits disturbed Shanxi, En Ming asked Governor Yu Xian to secretly escort missionaries out of the province, but Yu would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers ravaged Shanxi, En Ming urged Governor Yu Xian to smuggle missionaries out of the province in secret, but Yu refused.

sentences.zh: 兩宮西幸，毓賢率師赴固關，恩銘兼攝撫、籓事。

translations.literal: When the two palaces fled west, Yu Xian led troops to Guguan, and En Ming concurrently held the governorship and provincial administration affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the court fled west, Yu Xian marched to Guguan with his troops while En Ming took charge of both the governorship and the provincial administration.

sentences.zh: 車駕至太原，召見，奏對，聲淚俱下。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached Taiyuan, he was summoned and questioned; in memorializing his replies, voice and tears came together.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession reached Taiyuan, he was summoned to audience; as he answered, his voice broke and tears streamed down.

sentences.zh: 補歸綏道。

translations.literal: He was appointed to Guisui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed intendant of Guisui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 先是口外七廳殺教士四十餘、教民二千餘，待撫者眾且亟，到官後，即發帑金倉粟濟之。

translations.literal: Previously in the seven departments beyond the pass more than forty missionaries and over two thousand converts had been killed; those awaiting relief were many and urgent. After he took office he immediately disbursed treasury funds and granary grain to succor them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the seven departments beyond the Great Wall, Boxers had killed more than forty missionaries and over two thousand Christian converts; relief was desperately needed. As soon as he took office, he released treasury silver and granary grain to aid them.

sentences.zh: 會聯軍至大同，民駭走。

translations.literal: When the allied armies reached Datong, the people fled in terror.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies reached Datong, the populace fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 復令教士諷喻，並與執爭，乃引兵去。

translations.literal: He again had missionaries persuade them and argued with the commander; only then did the allied forces withdraw their troops.
translations.idiomatic: He sent missionaries to reason with the troops and personally argued with the commander until the allied forces finally withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，調直隸口北道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was transferred to the Koubei Circuit of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he was transferred to Koubei Circuit in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 時經拳亂後，十三廳、州、縣教民洶洶圖報復，宣化華教士且強逼民入教，恩銘患之，與西教士反覆辨論，始允約束，民、教始安。

translations.literal: At that time, after the Boxer turmoil, Christian converts in thirteen departments, prefectures, and counties were fiercely plotting revenge; a Chinese missionary in Xuanhua even forced people to join the church. En Ming was troubled by this and argued repeatedly with Western missionaries until they agreed to restrain themselves; only then did laymen and converts settle down.
translations.idiomatic: In the aftermath of the Boxer uprising, Christian converts across thirteen jurisdictions were clamoring for revenge, and a Chinese missionary in Xuanhua was even coercing villagers into conversion. Disturbed, En Ming debated the matter at length with Western missionaries until they agreed to restrain their conduct, and peace was restored between converts and the local population.

sentences.zh: 遷浙江鹽運使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Zhejiang salt transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as Zhejiang salt transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，調兩淮，晉江蘇按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was transferred to the Lianghuai salt region and promoted to Jiangsu provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1903 he was transferred to the Lianghuai salt administration and promoted to Jiangsu provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辦鹽務如故，杜私販，卹煎丁，歲增國課三十萬。

translations.literal: He managed salt affairs as before, stopped private trafficking, showed compassion to boiling workers, and increased annual state revenue by three hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: He managed the salt monopoly as before, curbed smuggling, eased conditions for salt-boilers, and increased annual state revenue by three hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 時論欲請改場垣為公司，並創煤煎輪運議，恩銘力陳其弊，事乃寢。

translations.literal: At the time public discussion urged converting salt fields into companies and also proposed coal-boiling and steam-wheel transport; En Ming forcefully stated their drawbacks, and the matters were dropped.
translations.idiomatic: Reformers then proposed converting government salt fields into joint-stock companies and introducing coal-fired boiling with steam-wheel transport. En Ming argued forcefully against both schemes, and the proposals were shelved.

sentences.zh: 授布政使，錄山西協餉功，晉頭品服。

translations.literal: He was appointed provincial treasurer; for his merit in coordinating Shanxi military funds he was granted first-rank court dress.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed provincial treasurer and, in recognition of his work coordinating Shanxi military supplies, was granted the privilege of first-rank court dress.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，署安徽巡撫，修廣濟圩，賑皖北水菑，民德之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he acted as Anhui governor, repaired the Guangji embankment, and relieved flood disaster in northern Anhui; the people were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1906 he served as acting governor of Anhui, repaired the Guangji embankment, and provided flood relief in northern Anhui, winning the people's gratitude.

sentences.zh: 紅蓮會匪自贛入，毀建德教堂，同時楚民寄居霍山者，亦與教堂啟釁，匪黨乘之，勢漸熾。

translations.literal: Red Lotus Society bandits entered from Jiangxi and destroyed the Jiande church; at the same time Hubei natives living in Huoshan also clashed with the church, and bandit factions took advantage so that their power gradually grew fierce.
translations.idiomatic: Red Lotus Society bandits crossed from Jiangxi and razed the church at Jiande, while Hubei settlers in Huoshan also clashed with local churches; rebel factions seized the opportunity, and unrest steadily intensified.

sentences.zh: 恩銘分​​軍援剿，並劾有司之釀禍者，地方以靖。

translations.literal: En Ming divided troops to reinforce suppression, and also impeached officials who had brewed the calamity; the region was thereby pacified.
translations.idiomatic: En Ming dispatched troops in several columns to suppress the uprising and impeached officials who had provoked the trouble, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是時廷議行新政，銳意興警察，於是承上指，整頓巡警學堂。

translations.literal: At that time the court discussed implementing new policies and was keen to establish police forces; accordingly he followed imperial guidance and reorganized the constabulary training school.
translations.idiomatic: The court was then pressing ahead with the New Policies and a modern police force; following imperial direction, he reorganized the constabulary training school.

sentences.zh: 適王之春薦道員徐錫麟才，遂畀以會辦。

translations.literal: Just then Wang Zhichun recommended the talent of circuit intendant Xu Xiling, and he was therefore given charge as co-manager.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhichun had just recommended the circuit intendant Xu Xiling as a man of talent, and En Ming appointed him to help run the school.

sentences.zh: 复念政劇財匱，援例清丈緣江洲地，按年收科，墾牧與樹藝並舉。

translations.literal: He also reflected that government affairs were heavy and finances depleted; following precedent he conducted a thorough survey of riverside sandbank lands, collected land tax by the year, and promoted both reclamation-pasturing and tree planting together.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful that government was overburdened and coffers empty, he followed precedent in surveying riverside sandbank lands, collecting annual land tax, and promoting both reclamation and afforestation.

sentences.zh: 朝旨又以民刑事訴訟法參用東、西律，下其議督撫。

translations.literal: An imperial edict also ordered that civil and criminal procedure law draw on Eastern and Western statutes, and sent the discussion down to governors and governors-general.
translations.idiomatic: The throne also ordered that new civil and criminal procedure codes draw on Eastern and Western law, and referred the matter to provincial governors for comment.

sentences.zh: 恩銘慮皖北民悍，為擇其不便者六事具以報。

translations.literal: En Ming feared the people of northern Anhui were fierce; he selected six provisions that would be inconvenient for them and reported them in full.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the fierce temperament of northern Anhui's populace, En Ming identified six provisions of the new code that would prove impracticable there and reported them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 明年夏，巡警學生卒業，恩銘詣校試驗，錫麟乘間以槍擊之，被重創。

translations.literal: The next summer, when constabulary students graduated, En Ming went to the school to examine them; Xiling seized an opening and shot him with a gun, inflicting grave wounds.
translations.idiomatic: The following summer, when the constabulary students graduated, En Ming came to the school to inspect them. Xu Xiling seized the moment and shot him, inflicting grave wounds.

sentences.zh: 知縣陸永頤銳身救護，先殞。

translations.literal: Magistrate Lu Yongyi rushed forward to protect him and was killed first.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Lu Yongyi threw himself forward to shield him and was killed first.

sentences.zh: 錫麟令經歷顧松閉校門，不從，亦斃之。

translations.literal: Xiling ordered bureau sub-director Gu Song to close the school gate; when he refused, Xiling killed him as well.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xiling ordered the bureau sub-director Gu Song to shut the school gate; when Gu refused, Xu killed him too.

sentences.zh: 從者負恩銘還署，遂卒。

translations.literal: His attendants carried En Ming back to the yamen, and he soon died.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants carried En Ming back to the yamen, where he soon died.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太子少保，諡忠愍，予皖省建祠，賞騎都尉兼一云騎尉世職，子咸麟襲。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Zhongmin, granted a shrine in Anhui, awarded the hereditary offices of Commandant of Cavalry with one additional Yun Commandant of Cavalry, and his son Xianlin inherited.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Loyal and Commiserated, granted a provincial shrine in Anhui, and awarded a hereditary commandant's rank with an additional junior commandancy for his son Xianlin to inherit.

sentences.zh: 恩銘既死，錫麟亦被獲。

translations.literal: After En Ming died, Xiling was also captured.
translations.idiomatic: After En Ming's death, Xu Xiling was captured as well.

sentences.zh: 錫麟者，浙江山陰人。

translations.literal: Xiling was a native of Shanyin, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xiling was a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 就學日本，以貲為道員。

translations.literal: He studied in Japan and through purchased qualification became a circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He had studied in Japan and bought his way into the rank of circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 志在謀綰軍隊，便起事，倉卒發難，卒被擒僇。

translations.literal: His aim was to plot control of military forces so as to launch an uprising; he rashly raised trouble and in the end was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: His plan was to seize control of the troops and launch a revolt, but he struck prematurely and was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 閱數年，復有孚琦、鳳山被刺事。

translations.literal: Several years later there were again the assassinations of Fu Qi and Feng Shan.
translations.idiomatic: A few years later came the assassinations of Fu Qi and Feng Shan.

sentences.zh: 孚琦，字樸孫，西林覺羅氏，隸滿洲正藍旗。

translations.literal: Fu Qi, style name Pusun, of the Xilin Gioro clan, registered in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Qi, style Pusun, was of the Xilin Gioro clan and registered in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 以工部筆帖式充軍機章京，累官郎中。

translations.literal: Starting as a Ministry of Works clerk, he served as a Grand Council secretary and rose through offices to director.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a clerk in the Ministry of Works, served as a Grand Council secretary, and rose to director.

sentences.zh: 三遷至內閣學士。

translations.literal: After three promotions he reached Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he reached the rank of Grand Secretariat academician.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十八年，授刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Guangxu he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he was appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，出為廣州副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he went out as Guangzhou vice commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1906 he was appointed vice commander-in-chief at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 頗以興學為己任，嘗設八旗工藝學校，整麗中小各學堂。

translations.literal: He took promoting education as his own responsibility, once established a Banner crafts school, and put in order primary and secondary schools.
translations.idiomatic: He made promoting education a personal mission, founded a Banner industrial arts school, and renovated primary and secondary schools throughout the city.

sentences.zh: 明年，權將軍。

translations.literal: The next year he acted as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he served as acting commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 將軍事故簡，孚琦慮即偷惰，日必讀書臨池，暇輒躬執勞役。

translations.literal: The commander's duties were few; Fu Qi feared he would soon grow idle, so every day he had to read books and practice calligraphy, and in spare time he personally performed labor.
translations.idiomatic: The general's duties were light, and Fu Qi feared he would lapse into idleness; he read and practiced calligraphy daily, and in his spare time took up manual labor himself.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，再攝將軍篆。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he again held the commander's seal in acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: In 1910 he again served as acting commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 明年春，赴城東燕塘勘旗地，兼閱試演軍用飛機。

translations.literal: The next spring he went east of the city to Yantang to survey banner lands and also to observe trial demonstrations of military aircraft.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring he went to Yantang east of the city to survey banner lands and to watch a trial flight of a military aircraft.

sentences.zh: 有溫生才者，隸革命黨，事暗殺。

translations.literal: There was one Wen Shengcai, affiliated with the revolutionary party, who practiced assassination.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Wen Shengcai, affiliated with the revolutionary party, specialized in assassination.

sentences.zh: 會日將暮，伏道左，俟其至，轟擊之，遂殞命。

translations.literal: As the day was nearing dusk, he lay in ambush on the left of the road; when Fu Qi arrived he blasted him with a bomb, and Fu Qi lost his life.
translations.idiomatic: As dusk fell, Wen lay in wait by the roadside and detonated a bomb when Fu Qi passed, killing him instantly.

sentences.zh: 生才被執，論棄市。

translations.literal: Shengcai was arrested and sentenced to public execution.
translations.idiomatic: Wen was captured and sentenced to execution in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上憫惻，諡恪愍，命鳳山代之。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor was moved to compassion, granted the posthumous title Kemin, and ordered Feng Shan to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor was deeply moved, granted Fu Qi the posthumous title Respectful and Commiserated, and appointed Feng Shan to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 鳳山，字禹門，劉氏，隸漢軍鑲白旗。

translations.literal: Feng Shan, style name Yumen, of the Liu clan, registered in the Han Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shan, style Yumen, was of the Liu clan and registered in the Han Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以繙譯舉人襲佐領，充驍騎營翼長、印務章京。

translations.literal: Through translator juren status he inherited an assistant commandant post, and served as wing commander of the Valiant Cavalry Brigade and seal affairs secretary.
translations.idiomatic: As a translator juren he inherited an assistant commandant's post and served as wing commander of the Valiant Cavalry Brigade and as a seal affairs secretary.

sentences.zh: 累遷參領，總辦東安巡捕分局。

translations.literal: He was promoted through offices to company commander and took general charge of the Dong'an patrol sub-bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to company commander and took charge of the Dong'an patrol sub-bureau.

sentences.zh: 聯軍入京，法人在其轄境刃傷商民，縛致總局，請毋少貸，論如律。

translations.literal: When the allied armies entered the capital, Frenchmen in his jurisdiction wounded merchants with blades; he bound them and sent them to headquarters, requesting no leniency, and they were judged according to law.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies occupied Beijing, French soldiers in his jurisdiction stabbed local merchants; he arrested them and sent them to headquarters, insisting they be punished to the full extent of the law.

sentences.zh: 擢副都統，訓練近畿陸軍，著聲績。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commander-in-chief, trained the metropolitan land army, and won renown for achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to vice commander-in-chief, he trained the metropolitan land forces and won a distinguished reputation.

sentences.zh: 除西安將軍，仍留治兵事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Xi'an commander-in-chief but still remained to manage military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commander-in-chief at Xi'an but remained in charge of military affairs in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 宣統初，改練軍歸部節度，始解兵柄。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuantong the trained army was transferred to ministry control, and only then did he relinquish military authority.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xuantong reign the trained forces were placed under ministry control, and only then did he relinquish his command.

sentences.zh: 三年，授廣州將軍，未行而武昌事起。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed Guangzhou commander-in-chief; before he departed the Wuchang affair arose.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 he was appointed commander-in-chief at Guangzhou, but before he could take up the post the Wuchang uprising broke out.

sentences.zh: 香港為粵民黨藪，謀攻省城，眾阻其勿往，曰：「吾大臣也，不可不奉詔。」

translations.literal: Hong Kong was a lair of Guangdong revolutionary party members plotting to attack the provincial capital; the crowd urged him not to go. He said: "I am a great minister; I cannot fail to obey the imperial decree."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Kong had become a revolutionary stronghold, and conspirators were plotting to seize the provincial capital. Others urged him not to go, but he said, "I am a senior minister of the realm; I cannot disobey the imperial summons."

sentences.zh: 遂毅然去。

translations.literal: He then resolutely departed.
translations.idiomatic: And he set out resolutely.

sentences.zh: 將至時，總督及布、按以下官皆不敢出迓，或勸宜微服先入城，毋蹈孚將軍覆轍，鳳山不可。

translations.literal: When he was about to arrive, the governor and officials from provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner downward all dared not go out to welcome him; some urged that he should enter the city first in plain dress and not repeat General Fu's disaster. Feng Shan would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: As he approached, neither the governor nor any official below the rank of provincial treasurer dared go out to receive him. Some urged him to enter the city in disguise first, lest he meet the same fate as General Fu, but Feng Shan refused.

sentences.zh: 日午，輿衛導行，抵南城外，黨人匿市廛簷際擲炸彈，屋瓦摧壓，從者死十餘人，街石寸寸裂。

translations.literal: At noon, with sedan escort leading the way, he reached outside the south gate; party members hidden under market eaves threw bombs, crushing roof tiles; more than ten attendants died, and street stones cracked inch by inch.
translations.idiomatic: At noon, with his full escort, he reached the area outside the south gate. Revolutionaries concealed under the market eaves hurled bombs; roof tiles were shattered, more than ten of his attendants were killed, and the paving stones cracked to pieces.

sentences.zh: 暮得鳳山屍，焦爛無完膚。

translations.literal: At dusk Feng Shan's corpse was found, charred and without intact skin.
translations.idiomatic: By evening his body was recovered, charred beyond recognition.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太子少保，諡勤節，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Qinjie, and awarded a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry office.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given the posthumous title Diligent and Upright, and granted a hereditary commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 端方，字午橋，托忒克氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Duan Fang, style name Wuqiao, of the Totek clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Fang, style Wuqiao, was of the Totek clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 由廕生中舉人，入貲為員外郎，遷郎中。

translations.literal: Through yinsheng status he passed the provincial examinations, purchased qualification as vice director, and was transferred to director.
translations.idiomatic: A yinsheng who qualified as a provincial graduate, he bought his way into the post of vice director and was later promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，出為直隸霸昌道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu he went out as Bazhou-Changping Circuit intendant of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 he was appointed intendant of Bazhou-Changping Circuit in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 京師創設農工商局，徵還，筦局務，賞三品卿銜。

translations.literal: When the capital established the Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce Bureau, he was recalled to manage bureau affairs and was granted third-rank ministerial commissioner rank.
translations.idiomatic: When Beijing established the Bureau of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce, he was recalled to head it and was granted third-rank ministerial commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 上勸善歌，稱旨。

translations.literal: He presented songs to encourage virtue to the throne, which accorded with imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: He presented moral exhortation songs to the throne, which pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 除陝西按察使，晉布政使，護巡撫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Shaanxi provincial judicial commissioner, promoted to provincial treasurer, and acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Shaanxi provincial judicial commissioner, promoted to provincial treasurer, and served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 兩宮西幸，迎駕設行在。

translations.literal: When the two palaces fled west, he welcomed the imperial carriage and established a traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the court fled west, he received the imperial procession and established a temporary palace.

sentences.zh: 調河南布政使，擢湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Henan provincial treasurer and promoted to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Henan as provincial treasurer and promoted to governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，攝湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he acted as Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he served as acting governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 三十年，調江蘇，攝兩江總督。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to Jiangsu and acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1904 he was transferred to Jiangsu and served as acting governor-general of Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 尋調湖南。

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 顓志興學，資遣出洋學生甚眾。

translations.literal: He devoted his will to promoting education and sent abroad many students at state expense.
translations.idiomatic: He was devoted to education and sponsored a great many students to study overseas.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，召入覲。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was summoned to audience at court.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was summoned to audience at court.

sentences.zh: 擢閩浙總督，未之官，詔赴東西各國考政治。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general but had not taken office when an edict ordered him to go to Eastern and Western countries to study government.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang but had not yet taken up the post when an edict sent him abroad to study the governments of East and West.

sentences.zh: 既還，成歐美政治要義，獻上，議改立憲自此始。

translations.literal: After he returned he completed Essentials of European and American Government and presented it; discussion of changing to constitutional government began from this.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he completed Essentials of European and American Government and presented it to the throne, and from this point debate over constitutional reform began in earnest.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，移督兩江，設學堂，辦警察，造兵艦，練陸軍，定長江巡緝章程，聲聞益著。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was transferred to govern Liangjiang, established schools, organized police, built warships, trained the land army, fixed regulations for Yangtze patrol and suppression, and his reputation grew still greater.
translations.idiomatic: In 1906 he was transferred to Liangjiang, where he founded schools, organized a modern police force, built warships, trained land forces, and drafted Yangtze patrol regulations; his reputation grew ever greater.

sentences.zh: 宣統改元，調直隸。

translations.literal: When Xuantong replaced the reign title he was transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xuantong reign began, he was transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 孝欽皇后梓宮奉安，端方輿從橫衝神路，農工商部左丞李國傑劾之，坐違制免。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Xiaoci's coffin was installed in its final resting place, Duan Fang's sedan escort charged across the spirit way; Left Vice Minister of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce Li Guojie impeached him, and he was dismissed for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the final interment of Empress Dowager Cixi's coffin, Duan Fang's procession cut across the sacred spirit way. Li Guojie, left vice minister of the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry, and Commerce, impeached him, and he was dismissed for violating court protocol.

sentences.zh: 既而御史胡思敬又彈其貪橫凡十罪，事下張人駿，覆奏入，以不治崖檢被訶斥，因已罷官，貸勿問。

translations.literal: Soon after Censor Hu Sijing again impeached him for ten crimes of greed and arrogance; the matter was sent down to Zhang Renjun, whose memorial reply entered court; because he did not restrain his conduct on the cliff edge he was rebuked, but since he had already been dismissed from office, he was pardoned and not pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hu Sijing then impeached him on ten counts of corruption and arrogance. The case was referred to Zhang Renjun, whose report rebuked Duan Fang for lax personal conduct; since he had already been dismissed, no further punishment was imposed.

sentences.zh: 三年，命以侍郎督辦川漢、粵漢鐵路。

translations.literal: In the third year he was ordered as vice minister to supervise the Sichuan-Hankou and Guangdong-Hankou railways.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 he was appointed vice minister to supervise the Sichuan-Hankou and Guangdong-Hankou railway projects.

sentences.zh: 時部議路歸國有，而收路章條湘、川不一致，川人大譁。

translations.literal: At that time the ministry discussed returning railways to state ownership, but the articles for reclaiming railways were inconsistent between Hunan and Sichuan, and the people of Sichuan raised a great outcry.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry was then debating nationalization of the railways, but the terms for buying back private lines differed between Hunan and Sichuan, provoking an uproar in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 川、鄂為黨人所萃，乘機竊發。

translations.literal: Sichuan and Hubei were where party members gathered; they seized the opportunity to rise in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan and Hubei were revolutionary strongholds, and conspirators seized the moment to strike.

sentences.zh: 端方行次漢口，亟入川，並劾川督趙爾豐操切。

translations.literal: Duan Fang, traveling and stopping at Hankou, urgently entered Sichuan and also impeached Sichuan Governor Zhao Erfeng for harsh handling.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through Hankou, Duan Fang pressed on into Sichuan and also impeached Governor Zhao Erfeng for his heavy-handed policies.

sentences.zh: 命率師往按，尋詔代攝其事。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead troops to investigate; soon an edict had him act in Zhao's place and take charge of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead troops to investigate the unrest, and soon received an edict placing him in charge of Sichuan affairs in Zhao Erfeng's stead.

sentences.zh: 所過州縣，輒召父老宣喻威德。

translations.literal: In every prefecture and county he passed through he would summon elders to proclaim and explain imperial majesty and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: At every prefecture and county along his route he summoned local elders to proclaim the court's majesty and benevolence.

sentences.zh: 至資州，所部鄂軍皆變，軍官劉怡鳳率眾入室，語不遜，端方以不屈遇害。

translations.literal: When he reached Zizhou, the Hubei troops under his command all mutinied; officer Liu Yifeng led the crowd into his quarters with insolent words, and Duan Fang was killed for refusing to yield.
translations.idiomatic: At Zizhou his Hubei troops mutinied en masse. Officer Liu Yifeng led the mutineers into Duan Fang's quarters with insolent demands, and Duan Fang was killed when he refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 端方性通侻，不拘小節。

translations.literal: Duan Fang's nature was easy and unconventional; he did not bind himself to small proprieties.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Fang was easygoing by nature and unconcerned with petty formalities.

sentences.zh: 篤嗜金石書畫，尤好客，建節江、鄂，燕集無虛日，一時文采几上希畢、阮雲。

translations.literal: He deeply loved bronze inscriptions, stone tablets, calligraphy, and painting, and was especially fond of guests; when he held authority in Jiangsu and Hubei, banquets had no idle day, and for a time literary brilliance nearly reached Xi Bi and Ruan Yun.
translations.idiomatic: He was a passionate collector of bronzes, steles, calligraphy, and painting, and a generous host. During his tenure in Jiangsu and Hubei he held literary gatherings almost daily, and for a time the brilliance of his salon nearly rivaled that of Xi Bi and Ruan Yun.

sentences.zh: 弟端錦，字叔絅。

translations.literal: His younger brother Duan Jin, style name Shujiong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Duan Jin, style Shujiong.

sentences.zh: 河南知府。

translations.literal: Prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 赴東西各國考路政，箸日本鐵道紀要。

translations.literal: He went to Eastern and Western countries to study railway administration and authored Summary of Japanese Railways.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled abroad to study railway administration and wrote Summary of Japanese Railways.

sentences.zh: 從兄入川，變作，以身蔽其兄，極口詈軍士無良，同被殺。

translations.literal: He followed his elder brother into Sichuan; when the mutiny occurred he used his body to shield his brother, cursed the soldiers at length for their wickedness, and was killed together with him.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied his brother into Sichuan. When the mutiny broke out, he shielded Duan Fang with his own body and cursed the mutineers as faithless wretches; he was killed alongside his brother.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈端方太子太保，諡忠敏；

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, Duan Fang was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Zhongmin;
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, Duan Fang was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Loyal and Keen;

sentences.zh: 端錦諡忠惠。

translations.literal: Duan Jin was given the posthumous title Zhonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Jin received the posthumous title Loyal and Gracious.

sentences.zh: 其時轉餉官劉燧，荊州駐防、舉人、都司赫成額，並赴水死。

translations.literal: At that time grain transport officer Liu Sui, and Jingzhou garrison juren and brigade commander He Cheng'e, all died by drowning.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time, grain transport officer Liu Sui and He Cheng'e, a juren of the Jingzhou garrison who served as brigade commander, also drowned themselves.

sentences.zh: 松壽，字鶴齡，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Song Shou, style name Heling, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou, style Heling, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 以廕生官工部筆帖式，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: Through yinsheng status he became a Ministry of Works clerk and was promoted through offices to director.
translations.idiomatic: A yinsheng, he entered the Ministry of Works as a clerk and rose to director.

sentences.zh: 出為陝西督糧道。

translations.literal: He went out as Shaanxi grain transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Shaanxi grain transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十一年，晉山東按察使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu he was promoted to Shandong provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was promoted to Shandong provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年，調江西，晉江寧布政使。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Jiangxi and promoted to Jiangning provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Jiangxi and promoted to provincial treasurer of Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢江西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 he was promoted to governor of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 越三載，移撫江蘇，歷河南，加尚書銜，所蒞皆稱職。

translations.literal: After three years he was transferred to govern Jiangsu, then served in Henan, was granted ministerial rank, and in every post he held was said to perform his duties well.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later he was transferred to Jiangsu, later served in Henan, and was granted ministerial rank; in every post he was regarded as competent.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，召為工部右侍郎，兼正藍旗蒙古副都統，尋授熱河都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was summoned as vice minister of the Ministry of Works and concurrently Mongol vice commander-in-chief of the Plain Blue Banner; soon after he was appointed Rehe commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he was recalled as vice minister of Works and concurrently Mongol vice commander-in-chief of the Plain Blue Banner, and soon after was appointed commander-in-chief at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 疏陳續修礦章四條，允行。

translations.literal: He memorialized proposing four articles for revising mining regulations, and they were approved.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized proposing four articles for revising mining regulations, and the court approved them.

sentences.zh: 復以地控蒙部，號難治，條上吏治、軍政、興學、理財方略甚悉。

translations.literal: He also noted that the territory bordered Mongol departments and was said to be hard to govern; he submitted detailed strategies for civil administration, military affairs, promoting education, and managing finances.
translations.idiomatic: He also observed that the region bordered Mongol territories and was notoriously difficult to govern, and submitted detailed proposals on civil administration, military affairs, education, and fiscal policy.

sentences.zh: 又召還，拜兵部尚書。

translations.literal: He was again recalled and appointed minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled again and appointed minister of War.

sentences.zh: 明年，調工部。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 又明年，出為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: The year after that he went out as Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that he was appointed commander-in-chief of Chahar.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，授閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was appointed Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907 he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 居官垂二十年，不務赫赫名，然律己以廉，臨下以寬，為時論所美。

translations.literal: In office for nearly twenty years, he did not pursue a resounding reputation, yet he disciplined himself with integrity and treated subordinates with leniency, and was praised in contemporary opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Over nearly twenty years in office he sought no fame for himself, but governed with personal integrity and treated subordinates generously, winning praise from contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年秋，鄂、湘、江、浙新軍踵變，閩軍乘之，將舉事，使人要松壽，令繳駐防營軍械，斥之，遂決戰，初獲勝，繼乃大挫，憤甚，飲金以殉。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Xuantong the new armies of Hubei, Hunan, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang mutinied in succession; Fujian troops seized the moment and were about to rise. They sent men to demand of Song Shou that he surrender the garrison camp's arms; he rebuffed them and decided on battle. At first he won, but afterward suffered a great defeat; deeply angered, he drank gold and died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of 1911, as new armies in Hubei, Hunan, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang mutinied one after another, Fujian troops followed suit and prepared to revolt. They sent men demanding that Song Shou surrender the garrison's arms; he refused and gave battle. He won an initial engagement but then suffered a crushing defeat; in bitter rage he took poison and died for the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太子少保，予二等輕車都尉世職，諡忠節。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, awarded a second-rank hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots office, and given the posthumous title Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted a second-rank hereditary commandant's title, and given the posthumous title Loyal and Upright.

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐，字季和，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Zhao Erfeng, style name Jihe, of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erfeng, style Jihe, was of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 以山西知縣累保道員。

translations.literal: Starting as a Shanxi county magistrate he was repeatedly recommended until he reached circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from county magistrate in Shanxi through repeated recommendations to the rank of circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 四川總督錫良疏薦其才，權永寧道，剿匪嚴誅捕。

translations.literal: Sichuan Governor-General Xi Liang memorialized recommending his talent; he acted as Yongning Circuit intendant and in suppressing bandits was severe in pursuit and execution.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Governor-General Xi Liang recommended him for his ability; he served as acting intendant of Yongning Circuit and waged a ruthless campaign against bandits.

sentences.zh: 駐藏大臣鳳全遇害，調建昌。

translations.literal: When Tibet Commissioner Feng Quan was killed, he was transferred to Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: When Tibet Commissioner Feng Quan was murdered, Zhao was transferred to Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 會克巴塘，建議籌邊，充川滇邊務大臣，護總督，改駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: When Batang was taken he proposed planning frontier affairs, served as Sichuan-Yunnan frontier commissioner, acted as governor-general, and was changed to Tibet commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After Batang was recovered he proposed a comprehensive frontier policy, served as Sichuan-Yunnan frontier commissioner, acted as governor-general, and was later appointed Tibet commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以兵至打箭爐，改設康定、登科等府。

translations.literal: With troops he reached Dajianlu and established prefectures such as Kangding and Dengke.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced with troops to Dajianlu and established prefectural administrations at Kangding, Dengke, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，仍專任邊務。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong he still held exclusive charge of frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 he continued to hold sole responsibility for frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 藏兵犯巴塘，擊敗之，乘勢收江卡等四部。

translations.literal: Tibetan troops attacked Batang; he defeated them and took advantage to recover the four districts including Jiangka.
translations.idiomatic: When Tibetan troops attacked Batang, he defeated them and seized the opportunity to recover four districts including Jiangka.

sentences.zh: 於是爾豐軍越丹達山而西，直抵江達，達賴喇嘛逃入印度。

translations.literal: Thereupon Erfeng's army crossed Danda Mountain westward and went straight to Jiangda; the Dalai Lama fled into India.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng's army then crossed Mount Danda to the west and advanced to Jiangda, driving the Dalai Lama into exile in India.

sentences.zh: 爾豐請一舉平藏，革教易俗，廷意不欲開釁，阻之。

translations.literal: Erfeng requested to pacify Tibet in one stroke and reform religion and change customs; the court did not wish to provoke trouble and blocked him.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng urged a single campaign to pacify Tibet and reform its religion and customs, but the court, unwilling to provoke further conflict, blocked the proposal.

sentences.zh: 爾豐盡克三崖野番，決收回瞻對。

translations.literal: Erfeng completely subdued the wild tribes of the three cliffs and resolved to recover Nyarong.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng subdued the wild tribes of the three cliff regions and resolved to recover Nyarong.

sentences.zh: 三年，署四​​川總督，檄番官獻瞻對。

translations.literal: In the third year he acted as Sichuan governor-general and issued an order that Tibetan officials surrender Nyarong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 he served as acting governor-general of Sichuan and ordered Tibetan officials to surrender Nyarong.

sentences.zh: 爾豐遂入瞻對，設官治之。

translations.literal: Erfeng then entered Nyarong and established officials to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng then entered Nyarong and established a civil administration.

sentences.zh: 進克波密，並取白馬崗，收明正等土司，皆改流。

translations.literal: He advanced and took Bomi, also seized Baimagang, and recovered the native chieftains of Mingzheng and others, all converted to direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to capture Bomi and Baimagang, brought the Mingzheng chieftain and others under control, and converted their territories to direct administration.

sentences.zh: 計所收邊地縱橫三四千里，設治者三十餘區，一時皆懾於兵力，不敢抗。

translations.literal: In all the frontier lands recovered extended three or four thousand li in every direction; more than thirty districts were given administration, and for a time all were awed by military force and dared not resist.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier territory he recovered stretched three to four thousand li in every direction, with more than thirty administrative districts established; for a time all were cowed by his military power and dared not resist.

sentences.zh: 會川亂起，爾豐還省，集司道聯名奏請變更收路辦法，不允。

translations.literal: When Sichuan turmoil arose, Erfeng returned to the province; he gathered provincial and circuit officials to memorialize jointly requesting a change in the railway reclamation method, but it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: When unrest broke out in Sichuan, Erfeng returned to the provincial capital and joined other officials in a joint memorial asking the court to revise its railway nationalization policy, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 商民罷市，全省騷動。

translations.literal: Merchants closed their shops and the whole province was in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants shut down their businesses and the entire province was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 廷寄飭拏禍首，捕蒲殿俊等拘之，其黨圍攻省城。

translations.literal: An imperial courier edict ordered arrest of the ringleaders; Pu Dianjun and others were seized and detained, and their faction besieged the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict ordered the arrest of the ringleaders; Pu Dianjun and others were seized, and their followers besieged the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 督辦川路大臣端方劾爾豐操切，詔仍回邊務大臣，以岑春煊代總督。

translations.literal: Sichuan railway commissioner Duan Fang impeached Erfeng for harsh handling; an edict had him return to frontier commissioner and Cen Chunxuan replace him as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Railway commissioner Duan Fang impeached Erfeng for his heavy-handed policies; an edict restored Erfeng to his frontier post and appointed Cen Chunxuan governor-general in his place.

sentences.zh: 武昌變作，資政院議​​爾豐罷黜待罪，而朝旨已不能達川。

translations.literal: When the Wuchang mutiny occurred, the Political Consultative Council debated dismissing Erfeng to await punishment, but court edicts could no longer reach Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Wuchang uprising, the Political Consultative Council debated removing Erfeng pending trial, but imperial orders could no longer reach Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 重慶兵變，會匪蜂起，軍民環請獨立，爾豐遽讓政權於殿俊，殿俊自稱都督。

translations.literal: Chongqing troops mutinied, secret-society bandits rose everywhere, and soldiers and civilians surrounded him urging independence; Erfeng hastily yielded power to Dianjun, and Dianjun styled himself military governor.
translations.idiomatic: When troops mutinied at Chongqing and secret-society bandits rose everywhere, soldiers and civilians pressed for independence; Erfeng hastily ceded authority to Pu Dianjun, who declared himself military governor.

sentences.zh: 防軍復變，殿俊走匿，全城無主。

translations.literal: The defense troops mutinied again; Dianjun fled into hiding, and the whole city was without a master.
translations.idiomatic: The defense troops mutinied again; Pu Dianjun fled into hiding, and the city was left without a leader.

sentences.zh: 商民請爾豐出定亂，因揭示撫輯變兵。

translations.literal: Merchants and civilians asked Erfeng to come out and settle the turmoil; he therefore posted notices to pacify the mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants and civilians begged Erfeng to restore order, and he posted proclamations seeking to pacify the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 而標統尹昌衡率部入城，自為都督，羅綸副之，以兵攻督署，擁爾豐至貢院，爾豐罵不絕口，遂被害。

translations.literal: But brigade commander Yin Changheng led his troops into the city, styled himself military governor with Luo Lun as deputy, attacked the governor-general's yamen with troops, and had Erfeng escorted to the examination hall; Erfeng cursed without cease and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: But brigade commander Yin Changheng marched into the city, declared himself military governor with Luo Lun as his deputy, attacked the governor-general's yamen, and had Erfeng dragged to the examination hall, where Erfeng cursed them without cease until he was killed.

translations.literal: [One]
translations.idiomatic: Note [1]:

sentences.zh: 馮汝騤，字星岩，河南祥符人。

translations.literal: Feng Rukui, style name Xingyan, a native of Xiangfu, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Rukui, style Xingyan, was a native of Xiangfu in Henan.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年進士，選庶吉士，散館授戶部主事，充軍機章京，累遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examinations, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and after leaving the academy was appointed a director in the Ministry of Revenue, served as a Grand Council secretary, and was promoted through offices to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: A metropolitan graduate of 1883, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and, after leaving the academy, served as a director in the Ministry of Revenue, then as a Grand Council secretary, rising to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 出知四川順慶府，遭母憂去。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan and left office on his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan but left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起山東青州知府，調直隸大名。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was recalled as prefect of Qingzhou in Shandong and transferred to Daming in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning he was recalled as prefect of Qingzhou in Shandong and later transferred to Daming in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，遷湖北鹽法道。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to Hubei salt administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1905 he was transferred to Hubei salt administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年，調安徽徽寧池太道，遷甘肅按察使。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Anhui Huaining-Chizhou-Taiping Circuit and promoted to Gansu provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to Huaining-Chizhou-Taiping Circuit in Anhui and promoted to Gansu provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 未幾，晉陝西布政使，擢浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Shaanxi provincial treasurer and then to Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was promoted to Shaanxi provincial treasurer and then appointed governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，移撫江西，整稅務，省不急，官稱治辦。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was transferred to govern Jiangxi, put tax affairs in order, cut non-urgent expenditures, and officials said his administration was well handled.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 he was transferred to Jiangxi, where he reorganized tax collection, cut nonessential spending, and earned a reputation for effective governance.

sentences.zh: 朝議方厲行新政，乃復察民情，量財力，從容施設，士民安之。

translations.literal: The court was then vigorously implementing new policies; he again examined popular sentiment, measured financial capacity, and carried out reforms at a measured pace, and scholars and common people were at ease.
translations.idiomatic: As the court pressed ahead with the New Policies, he assessed local conditions and fiscal capacity and implemented reforms at a measured pace, winning the confidence of gentry and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，御史江春霖上其溺職徇私狀，事下安徽巡撫硃家寶覈覆，得白。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong Censor Jiang Chunlin memorialized his dereliction of duty and favoritism; the matter was sent down to Anhui Governor Zhu Jiabao to investigate, and he was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 Censor Jiang Chunlin impeached him for dereliction and favoritism; Anhui Governor Zhu Jiabao investigated and cleared him of the charges.

sentences.zh: 坐疏忽幹吏議，奪俸三月。

translations.literal: He was punished on the charge of negligence in supervising subordinates and had three months' salary withheld.
translations.idiomatic: He was nonetheless fined three months' salary for negligence in supervising subordinates.

sentences.zh: 三年，武昌變起，下游皆震。

translations.literal: In the third year the Wuchang mutiny arose and the lower Yangtze region was all shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 the Wuchang uprising broke out, sending shock waves through the lower Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 南昌軍相應和，脅汝騤為都督，號獨立，峻拒之。

translations.literal: Nanchang troops responded in concert, coerced Rukui to be military governor and proclaim independence; he sternly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Troops at Nanchang joined the uprising and tried to force Feng to serve as military governor and declare independence, but he firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 贛人故感其賢，導之出。

translations.literal: The people of Jiangxi had long been moved by his virtue and guided him out.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jiangxi, who respected his integrity, helped him escape.

sentences.zh: 至九江，乃仰藥以殉。

translations.literal: When he reached Jiujiang he took poison and died for the dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Jiujiang, he took poison and died for the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 詔旨軫惜，諡忠愍。

translations.literal: An imperial edict expressed deep sorrow and granted the posthumous title Zhongmin.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict expressed the court's grief and granted him the posthumous title Loyal and Commiserated.

sentences.zh: 陸鍾琦，字申甫，順天宛平人，本籍浙江蕭山。

translations.literal: Lu Zhongqi, style name Shenfu, a native of Wanping in Shuntian, with ancestral home in Xiaoshan, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhongqi, style Shenfu, was registered in Wanping, Shuntian, though his ancestral home was Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 父春榮，績學不遇，祭酒盛昱其弟子也。

translations.literal: His father Chunrong was learned but did not meet with success; Academician Sheng Yu was his disciple.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chunrong was a scholar who never found preferment; Academician Sheng Yu had been his student.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦少劬學，以孝稱。

translations.literal: Zhongqi in youth studied diligently and was known for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi studied diligently from youth and was known for his filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 光緒十五年進士，以編修辦直隸賑災，徐桐亟賞之。

translations.literal: A metropolitan graduate in the fifteenth year of Guangxu, as a compiler he handled Zhili famine relief; Xu Tong greatly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: A metropolitan graduate of 1889, he served as a Hanlin compiler managing famine relief in Zhili and won high praise from Xu Tong.

sentences.zh: 拳禍起，桐惑焉，鍾琦持異議，弗聽。

translations.literal: When the Boxer calamity arose, Tong was deluded by it; Zhongqi held a different view, but Tong would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer crisis erupted, Xu Tong was taken in by the movement; Zhongqi disagreed, but Xu would not heed him.

sentences.zh: 聯軍入，同年王懿榮、熙元、寶豐輩先後皆殉節。

translations.literal: When the allied armies entered, his examination-year fellows Wang Yirong, Xi Yuan, Bao Feng, and others all died for the dynasty in succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies occupied Beijing, his fellow graduates Wang Yirong, Xi Yuan, Bao Feng, and others died one after another defending the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦聞之，泣，闔戶自經，遇救獲免。

translations.literal: When Zhongqi heard of it he wept, shut his door and hanged himself, but was rescued and escaped death.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the news, Zhongqi wept, shut himself in, and attempted to hang himself, but was rescued in time.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，除江蘇督糧道。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed Jiangsu grain transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1903 he was appointed Jiangsu grain transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 越五載，遷江西按察使，調湖南，察吏嚴，定州縣結案功過章條，月計勘案數與其鞫訊狀限期報司，繇是獄鮮積滯。

translations.literal: After five years he was transferred to Jiangxi provincial judicial commissioner and then to Hunan; he inspected officials strictly, fixed regulations on merit and fault in case closure for prefectures and counties, and monthly tallied cases examined and their trial deadlines reported to the provincial office; thereby prisons rarely had accumulated delays.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later he was transferred to Jiangxi as provincial judicial commissioner and then to Hunan, where he enforced strict official discipline, established monthly reporting on case closures and trial deadlines, and thereby kept the courts largely free of backlog.

sentences.zh: 再移江蘇，多平反。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to Jiangsu and reversed many wrongful convictions.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred again to Jiangsu, he overturned many wrongful convictions.

sentences.zh: 宣統改元，晉布政使。

translations.literal: When Xuantong replaced the reign title he was promoted to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xuantong reign began, he was promoted to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 三年，擢山西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was promoted to Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 he was promoted to governor of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 到官未踰月，而武昌難作。

translations.literal: He had not been in office a full month when the Wuchang crisis broke out.
translations.idiomatic: He had been in office less than a month when the Wuchang uprising erupted.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦語次子敬熙曰：「大事不可為矣！

translations.literal: Zhongqi said to his second son Jingxi: "The great affair can no longer be accomplished!
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi told his second son Jingxi, "The great cause is lost!

sentences.zh: 省垣倘不測，吾誓死職。

translations.literal: If anything unforeseen happens at the provincial capital, I swear to die in my post.
translations.idiomatic: If anything goes wrong at the provincial capital, I swear to die at my post.

sentences.zh: 汝曹讀書明大義，屆期毋效婦仁害我！」

translations.literal: You have studied books and understand great principle; when the time comes do not imitate women's compassion and harm me!"
translations.idiomatic: You have been educated and understand what duty requires; when the time comes, do not let womanish sentiment interfere with what I must do!"

sentences.zh: 又曰：「生死之事，父子不相強，任汝曹自為之。

translations.literal: He also said: "Matters of life and death—father and sons do not compel one another; let you decide for yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: He added, "Life and death are your own to choose; a father cannot compel his sons—do as you see fit.

sentences.zh: 但吾孫毋使同盡，以斬宗祀。」

translations.literal: Only do not let my grandson perish together with us, lest the ancestral sacrifices be cut off."
translations.idiomatic: Only spare my grandson, so that our line does not end."

sentences.zh: 敬熙知父意決，入告母。

translations.literal: Jingxi knew his father's resolve was firm and went in to tell his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxi understood his father's resolve and went to tell his mother.

sentences.zh: 母曰：「汝父殉國，吾惟從之而已。」

translations.literal: His mother said: "Your father dies for the state; I can only follow him."
translations.idiomatic: His mother said, "Your father will die for the dynasty; I can only follow him."

sentences.zh: 敬熙以事亟，赴京語其兄光熙，偕還晉。

translations.literal: Jingxi, because affairs were urgent, went to the capital to speak with his elder brother Guangxi, and they returned to Shanxi together.
translations.idiomatic: With events moving swiftly, Jingxi went to Beijing to consult his elder brother Guangxi, and they returned to Shanxi together.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦馭新軍嚴，至是調兩營赴南路，時九月七日也。

translations.literal: Zhongqi had governed the new army strictly; at this time he transferred two battalions to the southern route—it was the seventh day of the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi had kept the new army under strict discipline; he now dispatched two battalions to the south—it was the seventh day of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 夜發餉，將以翼日行，而遲明變作，新軍突入撫署。

translations.literal: At night pay was issued, and they were to depart the next day; but at dawn the mutiny broke out and the new army suddenly entered the governor's yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Pay was issued that night, with departure planned for the next day, but at dawn the mutiny erupted and new army troops stormed the governor's yamen.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦出堂皇，僕李慶雲從，麾之弗去，且挺身出，先被戕。

translations.literal: Zhongqi came out to the main hall; his servant Li Qingyun followed; he waved him away but he would not leave, and instead stepped forward himself and was killed first.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi emerged into the main hall with his servant Li Qingyun in attendance. He ordered Li to withdraw, but Li refused and stepped forward instead, and was killed first.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦叱曰：「爾輩將反邪？」

translations.literal: Zhongqi shouted: "Are you people about to rebel?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi shouted, "Are you rebelling?"

sentences.zh: 語未竟，遽中槍而殞。

translations.literal: Before his words were finished he was suddenly struck by gunfire and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could finish, he was shot dead.

sentences.zh: 光熙奔救，亦被擊死。

translations.literal: Guangxi ran to rescue him and was also struck and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi rushed to his aid and was shot dead as well.

sentences.zh: 叛軍入內室，其妻唐氏抱雛孫起，並遇害。

translations.literal: Rebel troops entered the inner quarters; his wife Lady Tang rose holding her infant grandson, and all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel troops burst into the inner quarters; his wife Lady Tang rose with their infant grandson in her arms, and all three were killed.

sentences.zh: 詔褒其忠孝節義萃於一門，予諡文烈。

translations.literal: An edict praised that loyalty, filial piety, and righteousness were gathered in one household, and granted the posthumous title Wenlie.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised the loyalty, filial devotion, and righteousness that had united his entire household, and granted him the posthumous title Cultured and Upright.

sentences.zh: 妻唐旌表。

translations.literal: His wife Tang was granted an honorific tablet.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Tang was granted an official commendation.

sentences.zh: 光熙，本名惠熙，字亮臣。

translations.literal: Guangxi, original name Huixi, style name Liangchen.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi, born Huixi, style Liangchen.

sentences.zh: 少從盛昱遊，勵學。

translations.literal: In youth he associated with Sheng Yu and urged himself in study.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied under Sheng Yu and applied himself diligently to learning.

sentences.zh: 鍾琦遘危疾，嘗刲股和藥以進。

translations.literal: When Zhongqi suffered a grave illness, he once cut flesh from his thigh to mix with medicine and present it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongqi fell gravely ill, he cut flesh from his own thigh to prepare medicine for his father.

sentences.zh: 光緒三十年，成進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu he passed the metropolitan examinations and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1904 he passed the metropolitan examinations and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 東渡日本學陸軍，卒業歸，授編修，擢侍講。

translations.literal: He crossed east to Japan to study the land army; after graduating and returning he was appointed compiler and promoted to expositor.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Japan to study military science; after graduating he returned, was appointed Hanlin compiler, and was promoted to expositor.

sentences.zh: 贈三品京堂，諡文節。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted third-rank Beijing official rank and given the posthumous title Wenhui.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted third-rank capital official status and the posthumous title Cultured and Restrained.

sentences.zh: 論曰：恩銘遇刺，實在辛亥之前，蓋亂機已久兆矣。

translations.literal: The commentary says: En Ming's assassination actually occurred before the Xinhai year; disorder had long been foreshadowed.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: En Ming's assassination came before the Xinhai year of 1911; the seeds of chaos had been sown long before.

sentences.zh: 武昌變起，各行省大吏惴惴自危，皆罔知所措。

translations.literal: When the Wuchang mutiny arose, great officials of every province were fearful for themselves and all knew not what to do.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuchang uprising broke out, senior officials in every province were paralyzed with fear and knew not what to do.

sentences.zh: 其死封疆者，唯松壽、鍾琦等數人，或慷慨捐軀，或從容就義，示天下以大節，垂絕綱常，庶幾恃以復振焉。

translations.literal: Of those who died defending their territories, only Song Shou, Zhongqi, and a few others—some generously giving their lives, some calmly accepting death—showed the realm great integrity; as the bonds of propriety hung by a thread, perhaps the dynasty might yet rely on such examples to revive.
translations.idiomatic: Of those who died defending their posts, only Song Shou, Lu Zhongqi, and a handful of others—some giving their lives boldly, others meeting death with composure—held up for the realm the highest standard of loyalty. As the moral order of the dynasty hung by a thread, perhaps such examples might yet help it recover its footing.

sentences.zh: [一]按；

translations.literal: [One] Note:
translations.idiomatic: Note [1]:

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐傳，關內本與關外一次本相同，較此為詳。

translations.literal: The biography of Zhao Erfeng in the inland edition and the frontier first edition are the same, and are more detailed than this.
translations.idiomatic: The biography of Zhao Erfeng in the inland edition matches the frontier first edition and is more detailed than the version above.

sentences.zh: 全文附錄於後，作為參考。

translations.literal: The full text is appended below for reference.
translations.idiomatic: The full text is reproduced below for reference.

sentences.zh: 趙爾豐，字季和，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Zhao Erfeng, style name Jihe, of the Han Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Erfeng, style Jihe, was of the Han Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 父文穎，見忠義傳。

translations.literal: His father Wenying is treated in the Loyalty and Righteousness biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wenying is covered in the biographies of the loyal and righteous.

sentences.zh: 爾豐以鹽大使改知縣，選山西靜樂，歷永濟。

translations.literal: Erfeng changed from salt commissioner to county magistrate, was selected for Jingle in Shanxi, and served in Yongji.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng transferred from salt commissioner to county magistrate, served in Jingle, Shanxi, and later in Yongji.

sentences.zh: 清獄治盜，匪絕跡。

translations.literal: He cleared prisons and suppressed bandits until bandits vanished without trace.
translations.idiomatic: He cleared the courts and suppressed banditry until outlaws disappeared from his jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 躬捕蝗，始免災。

translations.literal: He personally caught locusts, and only then was disaster averted.
translations.idiomatic: He personally led locust eradication efforts, averting famine.

sentences.zh: 擢河東監掣同知，護河東道，以憂去。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Hedong salt control sub-prefect, acted as Hedong Circuit intendant, and left on mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hedong salt control sub-prefect, served as acting Hedong intendant, and left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十六年，聯軍入晉邊，山西巡撫錫良檄總營務處嚴防密偵之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the allied armies entered the Shanxi border; Shanxi Governor Xi Liang issued orders to the general camp affairs office to guard strictly and spy closely.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900, when allied forces entered Shanxi, Governor Xi Liang ordered the general camp affairs office to mount a strict defense and conduct close surveillance.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，駐藏大臣鳳全被害於巴塘，錫良以爾豐為建昌道，會提督馬維騏往討。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Tibet Commissioner Feng Quan was killed at Batang; Xi Liang appointed Erfeng Jianchang Circuit intendant and joined Provincial Commander Ma Weiqi in punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: In 1905 Tibet Commissioner Feng Quan was murdered at Batang; Xi Liang appointed Erfeng intendant of Jianchang Circuit and joined with Provincial Commander Ma Weiqi to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 維騏軍先發，爾豐從之，遂克巴塘。

translations.literal: Weiqi's army set out first; Erfeng followed, and Batang was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Weiqi's forces marched first, with Erfeng following, and Batang was recovered.

sentences.zh: 爾豐接辦善後，移兵討鄉城，匪退喇嘛寺，據碉死守。

translations.literal: Erfeng took charge of aftermath affairs, moved troops to attack Xiangcheng; bandits retreated to a lamasery and held blockhouses in desperate defense.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng handled post-conflict affairs and marched against Xiangcheng, where rebels retreated into a lamasery and held its blockhouses in a desperate defense.

sentences.zh: 爾豐斷水道，圍攻，番眾悉降。

translations.literal: Erfeng cut off the water supply, besieged them, and the tribal people all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng cut their water supply, laid siege, and the tribesmen surrendered en masse.

sentences.zh: 於是爾豐建籌邊議，錫良以聞，加爾豐侍郎，充川滇邊務大臣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Erfeng drafted frontier planning proposals; Xi Liang reported them; Erfeng was given vice minister rank and made Sichuan-Yunnan frontier commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng then drafted a comprehensive frontier policy, which Xi Liang reported to the throne; Erfeng was promoted to vice minister and appointed Sichuan-Yunnan frontier commissioner.

sentences.zh: 爾豐會錫良暨雲貴總督丁振鐸奏陳改流設官、練兵、招墾、開礦、修路、通商、興學諸端，廷議準撥開邊費銀百萬兩。

translations.literal: Erfeng joined Xi Liang and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ding Zhenduo in memorializing on converting native rule to direct administration, establishing officials, training troops, recruiting settlers, opening mines, building roads, promoting trade, and promoting education; the court approved allocating one million taels for frontier development.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng joined Xi Liang and Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Ding Zhenduo in a joint memorial proposing direct administration, official appointments, military training, land reclamation, mining, road building, trade, and education; the court approved one million taels for frontier development.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，錫良移任去，爾豐護四川總督。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year Xi Liang was transferred away and Erfeng acted as Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907 Xi Liang was transferred, and Erfeng served as acting governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 於是遙策邊事，凡前所奏陳，皆以次舉，察吏尤嚴，多所舉劾，僚屬肅然。

translations.literal: Thereupon he directed frontier affairs from afar; everything he had previously memorialized was carried out in turn; he inspected officials with especial severity, impeached many, and subordinates were awed into order.
translations.idiomatic: From the provincial capital he directed frontier policy, implementing his earlier proposals in sequence; he enforced strict official discipline, impeached numerous officials, and his subordinates conducted themselves with due restraint.

sentences.zh: 川南邊地多匪，移興文縣於建武，移永寧縣於古藺。

translations.literal: The southern Sichuan frontier had many bandits; Xingwen County was moved to Jianwu and Yongning County to Gulin.
translations.idiomatic: Banditry was rife along the southern frontier; he relocated Xingwen County to Jianwu and Yongning County to Gulin.

sentences.zh: 時外人議輪運入川，爾豐令川商自辦淺水輪以阻之，是為川江駛輪之始。

translations.literal: At that time foreigners discussed steam-wheel transport into Sichuan; Erfeng ordered Sichuan merchants to organize their own shallow-draft steam wheels to block this—this was the beginning of steam navigation on the Sichuan river.
translations.idiomatic: When foreigners proposed steam navigation on the Yangtze into Sichuan, Erfeng had local merchants organize shallow-draft steamers to forestall foreign competition—the beginning of steam navigation on the Sichuan river.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，以爾豐兄爾巽督川，改爾豐駐藏大臣，仍兼邊務，專邊藏事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, because Erfeng's elder brother Ersun governed Sichuan, Erfeng was changed to Tibet commissioner while still holding frontier affairs, specializing in Tibetan frontier matters.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 Erfeng's elder brother Ersun became governor of Sichuan; Erfeng was appointed Tibet commissioner while retaining his frontier portfolio, focusing exclusively on Tibetan affairs.

sentences.zh: 爾豐以經營全藏，宜以殖民為主，特慮恩信未孚，藏人疑阻，請仍責駐藏大臣聯豫駐守，而自巡視邊藏。

translations.literal: Erfeng held that managing all Tibet should take colonization as the main principle, but especially feared grace and trust were not yet won and Tibetans were suspicious and obstructive; he requested that Tibet Commissioner Lian Yu still be charged to garrison there, while he himself toured the frontier Tibetan regions.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng believed that governing Tibet required colonization as the foundation, but feared that Tibetan goodwill had not yet been won; he asked that Commissioner Lian Yu remain stationed in Lhasa while he toured the frontier regions himself.

sentences.zh: 先以巴塘為根據，寓遷民於兵墾，漸及藏地。

translations.literal: First taking Batang as base, he lodged relocated people in military reclamation colonies, gradually extending into Tibetan lands.
translations.idiomatic: He planned to use Batang as a base, settling migrants in military reclamation colonies and gradually extending into Tibetan territory.

sentences.zh: 又與爾巽會奏，設安康道，改打箭爐為康定府，設河口縣、裡化廳同知、稻成縣、貢噶嶺縣丞，巴安府三壩廳通判，定鄉縣，鹽井縣。

translations.literal: He also joined Ersun in a joint memorial establishing Ankang Circuit, changing Dajianlu to Kangding Prefecture, and setting up Hekou County, Lihua sub-prefect, Daocheng County, Gonggaling county magistrate, Ba'an Prefecture Sanba sub-prefect, Dingxiang County, and Yanjing County.
translations.idiomatic: He and Ersun jointly memorialized to establish Ankang Circuit, rename Dajianlu as Kangding Prefecture, and create a network of counties and sub-prefectures including Hekou, Lihua, Daocheng, Gonggaling, Ba'an, Dingxiang, and Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 詔促爾豐出關，因就成都駐防旗兵中選練西軍三營自隨。

translations.literal: An edict urged Erfeng to leave the pass; he therefore selected and trained three battalions of Western Army from the garrison banner troops at Chengdu to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Erfeng beyond the frontier; he selected and trained three battalions from the Chengdu garrison banner troops to accompany him west.

sentences.zh: 藏人聞之，聚兵三崖以阻。

translations.literal: When Tibetans heard of it they gathered troops at the Three Cliffs to obstruct him.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of his approach, Tibetans massed troops at the Three Cliffs to block his advance.

sentences.zh: 爾豐至打箭爐，適德格土司爭襲構亂，乃請旨往辦，迭敗之贈科、麻木，追奔至卡納沙漠地，眾悉降。

translations.literal: When Erfeng reached Dajianlu, the Dege chieftain was embroiled in succession strife; he requested imperial orders to handle it, repeatedly defeated them at Zengke and Mumu, pursued them to the Kana desert, and all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: At Dajianlu, Erfeng found the Dege chieftain embroiled in a succession dispute; he secured imperial authorization to intervene, defeated rebel forces at Zengke and Mumu, pursued them to the Kana desert, and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 爾豐分其地為五區，設登科府德化、白玉兩州，石渠、普同兩縣，置邊北道。

translations.literal: Erfeng divided the territory into five districts, established Dengke Prefecture with Dehua and Baiyu sub-prefectures, Shiqu and Putong counties, and set up the Northern Frontier Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng divided the territory into five districts, established Dengke Prefecture with Dehua and Baiyu sub-prefectures, Shiqu and Putong counties, and created the Northern Frontier Circuit.

sentences.zh: 德格地大，包有春科、高日兩土司，遂與靈蔥土司​​之郎吉嶺等地並改歸流。

translations.literal: Dege territory was large, encompassing the Chunke and Gaori chieftains; together with Lingcong chieftain's Langjiling and other places, all were converted to direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: Dege's extensive territory included the Chunke and Gaori chieftaincies; together with Langjiling under the Lingcong chieftain and other areas, all were brought under direct administration.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，朝意務懷柔藏人，采爾巽議，以經營西藏責聯豫暨幫辦溫宗堯，改爾豐專任邊務，駐巴塘，為藏聲援，劃察木多、乍丫歸邊轄。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong the court wished to conciliate Tibetans and adopted Ersun's proposal: managing Tibet was charged to Lian Yu and assistant Wen Zongyao; Erfeng was changed to hold frontier affairs exclusively, stationed at Batang as support for Tibet, and Chamdo and Zhaya were placed under frontier jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 the court adopted a conciliatory policy toward Tibetans following Ersun's advice: Lian Yu and Wen Zongyao were charged with governing Tibet proper, while Erfeng was assigned exclusively to frontier affairs, stationed at Batang as a military reserve, with Chamdo and Zhaya placed under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 川軍協統鍾穎率新軍三千入藏，被困察木多。

translations.literal: Sichuan army associate commander Zhong Ying led three thousand new troops into Tibet and was besieged at Chamdo.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan associate commander Zhong Ying led three thousand new army troops into Tibet and was trapped at Chamdo.

sentences.zh: 爾豐聞報，立馳往援，鍾穎軍出，並驅剿類伍齊、碩般多、洛隆宗、邊壩各部落逆番殆盡，三十九族波密、八宿等部咸納款。

translations.literal: When Erfeng heard the report he immediately rushed to rescue; Zhong Ying's army emerged, and together they drove and suppressed rebellious tribes of Leiwuqi, Shuobanduo, Luolongzong, and Bianba nearly to extinction; the thirty-nine clans of Bomi, Basu, and other departments all submitted tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the news, Erfeng rushed to the rescue; Zhong Ying's forces broke out, and together they nearly exterminated rebel tribes at Leiwuqi, Shuobanduo, Luolongzong, and Bianba; the Bomi, Basu, and other departments of the thirty-nine clans all submitted.

sentences.zh: 而江卡藏兵忽抄邊軍後路，犯巴塘，爾豐分兵擊敗之，乘勢收江卡、貢覺、桑昂、雜瑜四部落。

translations.literal: But Jiangka Tibetan troops suddenly struck the frontier army's rear, attacked Batang; Erfeng divided troops, defeated them, and took advantage to recover the four tribes of Jiangka, Gongjue, Sang'ang, and Zayu.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan troops from Jiangka then struck at the army's rear and attacked Batang; Erfeng dispatched forces to defeat them and seized the four tribes of Jiangka, Gongjue, Sang'ang, and Zayu.

sentences.zh: 於是爾豐軍越丹達山而西，直抵江達，距藏都拉薩僅六日程矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon Erfeng's army crossed Danda Mountain westward and went straight to Jiangda, only six days' journey from the Tibetan capital Lhasa.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng's army then crossed Mount Danda to the west and reached Jiangda, only six days' march from Lhasa.

sentences.zh: 二年，達賴喇嘛聞川軍將至，逃入英屬印度。
