translations.literal: In the second year the Dalai Lama, hearing Sichuan troops were about to arrive, fled into British India.
translations.idiomatic: In 1910, hearing that Sichuan troops were approaching, the Dalai Lama fled into British India.

sentences.zh: 爾豐請乘勝一舉平藏，革教易俗，廷意不欲開釁，阻之。

translations.literal: Erfeng requested to take advantage of victory to pacify Tibet in one stroke and reform religion and change customs; the court did not wish to provoke trouble and blocked him.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng urged a follow-up campaign to pacify Tibet and reform its religion and customs, but the court, unwilling to provoke further conflict, refused.

sentences.zh: 爾豐上疏力爭，略言：「我國幅瀼遼闊，強鄰環伺，屬地多有侵占。

translations.literal: Erfeng memorialized forcefully, stating in summary: "Our state's territory is vast and broad, strong neighbors surround and watch, and dependent territories are often encroached upon.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng memorialized forcefully, arguing: "Our empire is vast, powerful neighbors surround us on every side, and our frontier territories suffer constant encroachment.

sentences.zh: 自革達賴喇嘛，阿旺郎結叛逆，不惟藏人搖動，即外人覬覦之心亦因而愈熾。

translations.literal: Since the Dalai Lama was deposed and Ngawang Lobsang rebelled, not only were Tibetans shaken, but foreigners' covetous hearts also grew fiercer thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Dalai Lama was deposed and Ngawang Lobsang rebelled, Tibetans have been unsettled and foreign powers have grown ever bolder in their designs.

sentences.zh: 今我兵雖已入藏，然阿旺郎結已入英手，英人必挾以圖藏。

translations.literal: Now though our troops have entered Tibet, Ngawang Lobsang is already in British hands; the British will surely use him to plot against Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Though our troops have entered Tibet, Ngawang Lobsang is now in British hands, and the British will surely use him to advance their designs on Tibet.

sentences.zh: 若再姑容，將成大患。

translations.literal: If we indulge this further, it will become a great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If we indulge this situation further, it will become a grave threat.

sentences.zh: 臣因一面由巴塘進兵攻破南墩，一面由察木多進兵貢覺、桑昂、曲宗，我兵所到，番人親附，即洛隆宗、碩板多等亦皆遠來輸誠，備陳藏中苛虐情形，堅墾內屬。

translations.literal: Your servant therefore advanced from Batang to storm Nandun on one front, and from Chamdo to advance on Gongjue, Sang'ang, and Quzong on another; wherever our troops arrived, tribal people drew close in attachment; even Luolongzong, Shuobanduo, and others all came from afar to offer sincerity, fully stating the harsh and oppressive conditions in Tibet, and earnestly requesting to be incorporated within.
translations.idiomatic: I advanced from Batang to take Nandun on one front and from Chamdo toward Gongjue, Sang'ang, and Quzong on another; wherever our troops went, local tribes welcomed us. Even Luolongzong and Shuobanduo sent delegations describing Tibetan oppression and pleading to come under Chinese rule.

sentences.zh: 臣初意務在保境息民，並無開疆拓土之念。

translations.literal: Your servant's original intent was solely to protect the borders and give the people rest, with no thought of opening territory and expanding land.
translations.idiomatic: My original intent was solely to secure the frontier and pacify the people, not to expand our territory.

sentences.zh: 唯桑昂、曲宗屬地雜瑜與倮儸野番接壤，時有英人潛伏。

translations.literal: Only in the territories of Sang'ang and Quzong, Zayu borders the wild Lolo tribes, and British agents often lurk there.
translations.idiomatic: But Zayu, within the territories of Sang'ang and Quzong, borders Lolo tribal lands where British agents frequently operate in secret.

sentences.zh: 倮儸之南，為阿撒密，西為波密。

translations.literal: South of the Lolo is Assam; west is Bomi.
translations.idiomatic: Assam lies south of the Lolo territories; Bomi lies to the west.

sentences.zh: 英人若得雜瑜，即可直接波密，由工布入藏，與印度聯成一片。

translations.literal: If the British obtain Zayu, they can go straight to Bomi, enter Tibet through Gongbu, and link with India as one piece.
translations.idiomatic: If the British seize Zayu, they can advance directly to Bomi, enter Tibet through Gongbu, and link their Indian possessions into a continuous frontier.

sentences.zh: 則波密不可不收入版圖，其勢至迫。

translations.literal: Then Bomi cannot but be brought into the map of the realm; the situation is most pressing.
translations.idiomatic: Bomi must therefore be brought under our control; the situation is urgent.

sentences.zh: 請及此將邊兵所到之地，概收歸邊。

translations.literal: I request that while there is still time, all places reached by frontier troops be generally recovered to frontier administration.
translations.idiomatic: I urge that all territory our frontier troops have reached be incorporated under frontier administration while we still can.

sentences.zh: 並函商聯豫以烏蘇里江以東隸邊，以西屬藏。」

translations.literal: I also wrote to consult Lian Yu that east of the Wusuli River should belong to the frontier administration and west to Tibet."
translations.idiomatic: I also proposed to Lian Yu that territory east of the Wusuli River be placed under frontier administration and territory to the west under Tibetan jurisdiction."

sentences.zh: 疏入，樞府以外交責言為慮，聯豫亦不允劃界。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the Grand Council was concerned about diplomatic responsibility, and Lian Yu also would not agree to demarcation.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Council, fearing diplomatic complications, rejected the proposal, and Lian Yu also refused to demarcate the boundary.

sentences.zh: 然邊軍所得江達以內地，爾豐已逐漸改流，早成轄境矣。

translations.literal: Yet the territory within Jiangda gained by the frontier army—Erfeng had already gradually converted to direct administration and it had long become governed territory.
translations.idiomatic: Nevertheless, the territory within Jiangda that frontier troops had secured was already under direct administration and had long been incorporated into Erfeng's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 爾豐巡視各地，經貢覺、乍丫、江卡三部落，群以討三崖為請。

translations.literal: Erfeng toured various places, passing through the three tribes of Gongjue, Zhaya, and Jiangka; the masses all requested suppression of the Three Cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: Touring the frontier, Erfeng passed through Gongjue, Zhaya, and Jiangka, where local leaders unanimously petitioned him to subdue the Three Cliffs.

sentences.zh: 三崖者野番也，地險人悍，三部落苦其侵掠，嘗合攻之，反為所敗，官軍久不能討。

translations.literal: The Three Cliffs were wild tribes; terrain was perilous and people fierce; the three tribes suffered from their raids, once joined to attack them but were defeated in turn; government troops for long could not suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Cliffs were wild tribes in rugged terrain with fierce warriors; the three neighboring tribes had suffered their raids and once mounted a joint attack only to be defeated; government forces had long been unable to subdue them.

sentences.zh: 爾豐策三崖四周皆已改流，必為我用，遂派知府傅嵩矞率兵五路進攻，苦戰兩月，盡克上中下三崖全境，設官治之。

translations.literal: Erfeng judged that all around the Three Cliffs had been converted to direct administration and would surely serve him; he therefore dispatched prefect Fu Songyu to lead troops in five columns to attack, fought bitterly for two months, completely took the upper, middle, and lower Three Cliffs, and established officials to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng reasoned that the surrounding territories, now under direct administration, would support his campaign; he dispatched Prefect Fu Songyu with five columns of troops, and after two months of hard fighting subdued the upper, middle, and lower Three Cliffs and established civil administration.

sentences.zh: 初，藏人佔瞻對，爾豐屢請收回，廷議責聯豫議贖，久不得要領。

translations.literal: At first Tibetans occupied Nyarong; Erfeng repeatedly requested recovery; court discussion charged Lian Yu to negotiate redemption, but for long no clear terms were reached.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans had long occupied Nyarong; Erfeng repeatedly petitioned for its recovery, and the court ordered Lian Yu to negotiate its return, but talks dragged on without resolution.

sentences.zh: 至是邊地略定，獨瞻對為藏有，梗塞其中，爾豐乃決以策取之。

translations.literal: By this time the frontier was largely settled, but only Nyarong remained in Tibetan possession, blocking the middle; Erfeng then resolved to take it by strategy.
translations.idiomatic: By then the frontier was largely pacified, but Nyarong alone remained in Tibetan hands, blocking communications; Erfeng resolved to seize it by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 三年，爾豐調署四川總督，因薦嵩矞以道員用，代理邊務大臣，同行閱邊，繞道北路，先至孔撒、麻書，設甘孜委員，靈蔥、白利、倬倭、東科、單東、魚科各​​土司繳印改流，並受色達及上羅科野番降，瞻對民皆聞風請附。

translations.literal: In the third year Erfeng was transferred to act as Sichuan governor-general; he recommended Songyu for use as circuit intendant to act as frontier commissioner, and they traveled together to inspect the frontier by the northern route, first reaching Kongsa and Mashu, establishing a Garze commissioner; chieftains of Lingcong, Baili, Zhuowa, Dongke, Dandong, and Yukex each surrendered seals and were converted to direct rule; he also received the submission of Seda and upper Luoke wild tribes; Nyarong people all heard the wind and requested attachment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 Erfeng was appointed acting governor-general of Sichuan; he recommended Songyu as acting frontier commissioner, and they toured the frontier together via the northern route. At Kongsa and Mashu he established a Garze commissioner; the Lingcong, Baili, Zhuowa, Dongke, Dandong, and Yukex chieftains surrendered their seals and accepted direct administration; the Seda and upper Luoke tribes submitted; and the people of Nyarong petitioned to come under Chinese rule.

sentences.zh: 爾豐乃檄番官曰：「瞻對原系川屬，朝廷前以賞藏，設官徵糧。

translations.literal: Erfeng then issued a proclamation to Tibetan officials saying: "Nyarong originally belonged to Sichuan; the court formerly granted it to Tibet and established officials to collect grain tax.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng then issued a proclamation to Tibetan officials: "Nyarong originally belonged to Sichuan; the court once granted it to Tibet and established tax collection there.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，瞻人叛藏，則藏已失瞻；

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu the people of Nyarong rebelled against Tibet, so Tibet had already lost Nyarong;
translations.idiomatic: In 1894 the people of Nyarong rebelled against Tibet, and Tibet thereby lost control of the region;

sentences.zh: 川兵取瞻，則瞻為川有。

translations.literal: when Sichuan troops took Nyarong, then Nyarong belonged to Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: when Sichuan troops recovered it, Nyarong reverted to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乃藏人久佔不歸，迄今又十餘年矣，厚斂橫徵，民不堪命。

translations.literal: Yet Tibetans long occupied it without returning; now more than ten years have passed, with heavy levies and arbitrary exactions—the people could not bear their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tibetans have occupied it for more than ten years without returning it, imposing heavy taxes and arbitrary exactions until the people could endure no more.

sentences.zh: 應將瞻對仍獻朝廷，以表恭順。」

translations.literal: Nyarong should be presented again to the court to show respectful submission."
translations.idiomatic: Nyarong should be returned to the court as a sign of dutiful submission."

sentences.zh: 藏官畏爾豐威，獻戶籍去。

translations.literal: Tibetan officials feared Erfeng's authority, presented household registers, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The Tibetan officials, awed by Erfeng's authority, surrendered the household registers and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 瞻對民歡呼出迎，爾豐遂入瞻對，設官治之。

translations.literal: The people of Nyarong cheered and came out to welcome him; Erfeng then entered Nyarong and established officials to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Nyarong cheered and came out to welcome him; Erfeng entered Nyarong and established a civil administration.

sentences.zh: 野番俄落、色達均望風降。

translations.literal: Wild tribes of Eluo and Seda all submitted at the report of his approach.
translations.idiomatic: The Eluo and Seda tribes submitted at the news of his approach.

sentences.zh: 又波密自言其先為入藏漢兵，別成部落。

translations.literal: Moreover Bomi claimed that its ancestors were Han troops who entered Tibet and formed a separate tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Bomi also claimed descent from Han soldiers who had entered Tibet and formed a separate tribe.

sentences.zh: 爾豐前至察木多，波密呈驗所產棉布、糧食，證明確由漢出，並述其地與白馬崗接壤，在英、藏間，力請內附。

translations.literal: When Erfeng had earlier reached Chamdo, Bomi presented for inspection cotton cloth and grain they produced, proving clearly they came from Han sources, and stated their land bordered Baimagang, lay between Britain and Tibet, and urgently requested incorporation within.
translations.idiomatic: When Erfeng had earlier passed through Chamdo, Bomi presented samples of locally produced cotton and grain to demonstrate Han cultural ties, described their territory as bordering Baimagang between British and Tibetan spheres, and urgently petitioned for incorporation.

sentences.zh: 及爾豐師還，聯豫忽遣兵攻之，大敗乞援。

translations.literal: When Erfeng's army returned, Lian Yu suddenly sent troops to attack Bomi, suffered a great defeat, and begged for aid.
translations.idiomatic: When Erfeng's forces withdrew, Lian Yu launched an attack on Bomi, suffered a crushing defeat, and appealed for help.

sentences.zh: 至是，爾豐派鳳山由巴塘率邊兵二千往與聯豫參贊羅長崟軍共克波密，並取白馬崗。

translations.literal: At this time Erfeng dispatched Feng Shan from Batang to lead two thousand frontier troops to join Lian Yu's participating commissioner Luo Changyun's army in jointly taking Bomi, and also seized Baimagang.
translations.idiomatic: Erfeng then dispatched Feng Shan from Batang with two thousand frontier troops to join Commissioner Luo Changyun's forces under Lian Yu in capturing Bomi and Baimagang.

sentences.zh: 爾豐至打箭爐，收明正土司地及魚通、冷邊、沈邊、咱裡等土司印，皆改流。

translations.literal: When Erfeng reached Dajianlu he recovered the territory of the Mingzheng chieftain and the seals of the Yutong, Lengbian, Shenbian, Zali, and other chieftains, all converted to direct administration.
translations.idiomatic: At Dajianlu, Erfeng brought the Mingzheng chieftaincy and the Yutong, Lengbian, Shenbian, and Zali chieftaincies under direct administration.

sentences.zh: 計爾豐所收邊地，東西三千餘裡，南北四千餘裡，設治者三十餘區，詳土司傳。

translations.literal: In all, the frontier lands Erfeng recovered extended more than three thousand li east to west and more than four thousand li north to south; more than thirty districts were given administration—see the Native Chieftain biographies for details.
translations.idiomatic: In all, the frontier territory Erfeng brought under control stretched over three thousand li east to west and four thousand li north to south, with more than thirty administrative districts established—details are given in the Native Chieftain biographies.

sentences.zh: 會川亂起，爾豐還省。

translations.literal: When Sichuan turmoil arose, Erfeng returned to the province.
translations.idiomatic: When unrest broke out in Sichuan, Erfeng returned to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 初，商辦川漢鐵路公司集股銀二千餘萬，忽奉旨收歸國有，咸大譁，倡保路同志會，好事者爭附和，勢張甚。

translations.literal: At first the merchant-organized Sichuan-Hankou Railway Company had raised more than twenty million taels in shares; suddenly an edict ordered nationalization; all were greatly alarmed; they launched the Railway Protection Comrades Association; those eager for trouble vied to join, and momentum grew very strong.
translations.idiomatic: The merchant-organized Sichuan-Hankou Railway Company had raised over twenty million taels when an edict suddenly ordered nationalization; public outrage erupted, the Railway Protection League was formed, and agitators flocked to join until the movement grew formidable.

sentences.zh: 爾豐至成都，察亂已成，思弭解，集司道聯名電奏，請變更收路辦法，不允。

translations.literal: When Erfeng reached Chengdu he saw disorder had already formed and thought to mediate; he gathered provincial and circuit officials to telegraph jointly requesting a change in the railway reclamation method, but it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Arriving at Chengdu, Erfeng found unrest already widespread and sought to defuse it; he joined other officials in a joint telegram asking the court to revise its railway nationalization policy, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 商民罷市，同志會捧德宗神牌衝入督署，與護兵相持，頗有死傷，全省騷動。

translations.literal: Merchants closed shops; comrades carrying Emperor Dezong's spirit tablets rushed into the governor-general's yamen and confronted guard troops, with considerable dead and wounded; the whole province was in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants shut down their businesses; league members bearing spirit tablets of Emperor Guangxu stormed the governor-general's yamen and clashed with guards, leaving many dead and wounded; the entire province was in uproar.

sentences.zh: 廷寄飭拏禍首正法，爾豐不得已捕會首蒲殿俊等九人拘之。

translations.literal: An imperial courier edict ordered arrest of ringleaders for lawful execution; Erfeng had no choice but to arrest nine association leaders including Pu Dianjun and detain them.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict ordered the arrest and execution of the ringleaders; Erfeng reluctantly arrested nine league leaders including Pu Dianjun.

sentences.zh: 其黨圍攻省城，兵皆川產，不用命。

translations.literal: Their faction besieged the provincial capital; the troops were all natives of Sichuan and would not obey orders.
translations.idiomatic: Their followers besieged the provincial capital, but the troops, all Sichuan natives, refused to obey orders.

sentences.zh: 督辦川漢鐵路大臣端方方奉命援川，滯重慶，劾爾豐操切，詔仍回邊務大臣，以岑春煊代為總督。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Hankou railway commissioner Duan Fang was just ordered to aid Sichuan, lingered at Chongqing, impeached Erfeng for harsh handling; an edict had him return to frontier commissioner and Cen Chunxuan replace him as governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Railway commissioner Duan Fang, ordered to reinforce Sichuan, lingered at Chongqing and impeached Erfeng for heavy-handed policies; an edict restored Erfeng to his frontier post and appointed Cen Chunxuan governor-general in his place.

sentences.zh: 武昌變作，春煊阻不得往，端方至資州，遇害。

translations.literal: When the Wuchang mutiny occurred, Chunxuan was blocked and could not go; Duan Fang reached Zizhou and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuchang uprising broke out, Cen Chunxuan was unable to reach Sichuan; Duan Fang advanced to Zizhou and was killed.

sentences.zh: 資政院劾爾豐，罷黜待罪，而朝旨已不能達川。

translations.literal: The Political Consultative Council impeached Erfeng, dismissed him to await punishment, but court edicts could no longer reach Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Political Consultative Council impeached Erfeng and ordered his removal pending trial, but imperial orders could no longer reach Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 重慶兵變，會匪蜂起，軍民環請獨立，爾豐遽讓政權於殿俊，殿俊自稱都督，防軍復變，殿俊走匿，全城無主，商民請爾豐出定亂，因揭示撫輯變兵。

translations.literal: Chongqing troops mutinied, secret-society bandits rose everywhere, soldiers and civilians surrounded him urging independence; Erfeng hastily yielded power to Dianjun, who styled himself military governor; defense troops mutinied again, Dianjun fled into hiding, the whole city was without a master; merchants and civilians asked Erfeng to come out and settle turmoil, and he posted notices to pacify mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: When troops mutinied at Chongqing and secret-society bandits rose everywhere, soldiers and civilians pressed for independence; Erfeng hastily ceded authority to Pu Dianjun, who declared himself military governor; the defense troops mutinied again and Pu fled into hiding, leaving the city leaderless; merchants begged Erfeng to restore order, and he posted proclamations seeking to pacify the mutineers.

sentences.zh: 而標統尹昌衡率部入城，自為都督，羅綸副之，以兵攻督署，擁爾豐至貢院，爾豐罵不絕口，遂被害。

translations.literal: But brigade commander Yin Changheng led his troops into the city, styled himself military governor with Luo Lun as deputy, attacked the governor-general's yamen with troops, had Erfeng escorted to the examination hall; Erfeng cursed without cease and was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: But brigade commander Yin Changheng marched into the city, declared himself military governor with Luo Lun as deputy, attacked the governor-general's yamen, and had Erfeng dragged to the examination hall, where Erfeng cursed them without cease until he was killed.
